training_distribution: Two virgin original E60 collectors. Frozen case-specific W44 speed policies, common selected G/M. P2-full or P2-private is active at actual handovers, followed by the learned bounded timing residual. Validation geometry is excluded.
reward: W38 event integrals, unchanged signed legal progress, elapsed time, indentation, loaded slip, old cap changes, laps and physical failures. dt is measured from actual adjacent decisions.
planner_blind: Private released cells relevant to predicted load are set to the frozen constitutive prior only in the P2 forecast. The whole current footprint and shared current owners stay protected.
actor_blind: Withhold the 12 forecast heights including mixed-footprint aggregates. Merge unloaded virgin, recovered and residual into one known unloaded category. Preserve current measured forces, kinematics, current confirmation/bearing, footprint loaded, outside/missing, geometry, schedule, phase and residual history. Full and blind use the same candidates and action bounds.
credit: Two independent 128-transition streams, distinct batch 256, realized elapsed-time GAE, request raw log-density and real successor bootstrap. All masked requests stay in the update. At each node record all training decision outcomes including masked/ramp-only rows.
selection: At cumulative nodes use observed both-case action authority, measured cross-foot consequence, fixed identity and finite valid credit plus within-case return uncertainty/improvement from the training episodes. Full's last eligible node is chosen before validation. Private independently trains to exactly that seed's full node. Failure yields an incomplete pair.
development_gate: Twelve actual target events in each common short and recovered run, repeated same-state historical action above error on realized short loads, and short closed-loop benefit over matched private and fixed wait including costs. Full and private own original A/B E60.
